question: Will the world-mother goddess accompanied by Viṣṇu grant grace to the devotee?
premises: The goddess is addressed as world-mother
The devotee asks for her grace
inference: The devotee petitions the world-mother with Viṣṇu to be gracious.
plain_english: O goddess, O mother of the world, accompanied by Viṣṇu, be gracious to me.
